capabilities: Move files or folders to an archive folder, preserving relative paths
Move archived items back to their original location
Archive via commands and file or multi-file context menus
Create auto-archive rules matching files by age and name regex
Run auto-archive on a schedule with catch-up runs at startup
extras: README lists planned improvements (merge on folder archive conflict, rename option on file conflict), so some edge cases are not yet handled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move old or inactive notes into an archive folder, especially automatically on a schedule.
summary: Archive manager that moves notes and folders into a configured archive folder, with rule-based auto-archiving by file age or name.
